name: WithdrawalTracker
summary: WithdrawalTracker is a utility EA that monitors account balance changes to detect external withdrawals. When a withdrawal is identified, it automatically updates the stored initial deposit global variable to reflect the new account balance for use by other EAs.
summary_zh: WithdrawalTracker是一个工具型EA，通过监控账户余额变化来检测外部提现操作。当检测到提现时，它会自动更新存储的初始保证金全局变量，以便其他EA使用新的账户余额。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个账户监控工具。它通过5秒定时器持续追踪账户余额变化，核心逻辑是比较当前余额与预期余额的差异来判断是否发生提现。入场条件不适用，因为它不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理不涉及，EA不进行任何开仓或平仓。资金管理方面，它通过MT5全局变量存储初始保证金值，并在检测到提现后自动重置该值为当前余额，使得依赖该全局变量的其他EA能正确计算利润。检测逻辑依赖比较实际余额与预期余额（上次余额+交易利润）的差值，差值为负则判定为提现。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but an account monitoring utility. It uses a 5-second timer to continuously track account balance changes, with the core logic comparing the current balance against the expected balance to detect withdrawals. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trades. Position sizing is irrelevant as the EA never opens or closes positions. For money management, it stores the initial deposit value using MT5 global variables and automatically resets it to the current balance when a withdrawal is detected, enabling other EAs that depend on this global variable to correctly calculate profit. The detection logic relies on comparing the actual balance against the expected balance (last balance + trading profit), where a negative difference is interpreted as a withdrawal event.

parameters.name: EventSetTimer interval
parameters.description: 定时器间隔（秒），控制余额检查频率
parameters.description_en: Timer interval (seconds), controls balance check frequency

parameters.name: MyInitialDeposit
parameters.description: 全局变量名，格式为myDeposit_+账户登录ID
parameters.description_en: Global variable name, format: myDeposit_+account login ID

parameters.name: LastBalanceChecked
parameters.description: 上次检查时的账户余额

parameters.name: lastDealId
parameters.description: 上次检查时最后一笔交易的ID
parameters.description_en: ID of the last deal at previous check

pros: 自动检测账户提现并更新初始保证金值，减少手动维护工作
使用MT5全局变量存储数据，EA重启后数据不丢失
通过比较交易利润与余额变化来区分正常交易盈亏和外部提现，逻辑合理
pros_en: Automatically detects account withdrawals and updates the initial deposit value, reducing manual maintenance
Uses MT5 global variables for data persistence across EA restarts
Reasonably distinguishes normal trading P&L from external withdrawals by comparing trading profit against balance changes
cons: 条件判断语句存在逻辑错误：if(!NormalizeDouble(...) != NormalizeDouble(...))运算符优先级错误，!先作用于第一个值而非整组比较
仅检测提现（负变化），不处理存款（正变化）情况，功能不完整
5秒轮询频率可能在高频交易环境下错过中间状态变化，且消耗不必要的资源
cons_en: The conditional statement has a logic bug: if(!NormalizeDouble(...) != NormalizeDouble(...)) has operator precedence error — the ! applies to the first value, not the entire comparison
Only detects withdrawals (negative changes) but ignores deposits (positive changes), making the functionality incomplete
The 5-second polling interval may miss intermediate state changes in high-frequency trading environments and wastes resources when nothing changes
improvements: 修复运算符优先级错误，应改为if(NormalizeDouble(currentBalance,2) != NormalizeDouble(LastBalanceChecked,2))
增加对存款（正向非交易余额变化）的检测和处理逻辑
使用OnTradeTransaction事件驱动替代定时器轮询，提高响应效率并减少资源消耗
improvements_en: Fix the operator precedence bug — the condition should be if(NormalizeDouble(currentBalance,2) != NormalizeDouble(LastBalanceChecked,2))
Add detection and handling logic for deposits (positive non-trading balance changes)
Replace timer polling with OnTradeTransaction event-driven detection for better responsiveness and reduced resource consumption

risk_points: 运算符优先级错误导致余额变化检测逻辑可能异常，!操作符先作用于NormalizeDouble返回值而非整体比较表达式
全局变量名基于账户登录ID但未考虑多EA实例在同一账户运行的命名冲突
risk_points_en: Operator precedence bug may cause balance change detection to malfunction — the ! operator binds to the NormalizeDouble return value instead of the entire comparison expression
Global variable naming based on account login ID doesn't account for naming conflicts when multiple EA instances run on the same account

summary_en: WithdrawalTracker is a utility EA that monitors account balance changes to detect external withdrawals. When a withdrawal is identified, it automatically updates the stored initial deposit global variable to reflect the new account balance for use by other EAs.
